meta.title: Shop
meta.description: Spend match coins on airframes, upgrades, sail liveries, colourways and trail effects. Everything is earned in game — there is nothing to buy with real money.

header.title: Spend what you won
header.lead: Coins come from matches only. Nothing here costs real money and nothing here is time-limited.

shop.cosmeticNote: Colours and trails are cosmetic. They do not change how a kite flies.
shop.upgradeNote: Upgrades multiply a value the simulation already uses, so the effect is visible in the arena.

reducedEffects.label: Reduced effects
reducedEffects.description: Turns off match particles and heavy gradients. Helps on older or low-power devices. Also applied automatically if your system asks for reduced motion.

sound.label: Sound
sound.description: Line rasp, the snap of a cut, crashes and round cues. All synthesized in the browser — no audio files are downloaded.

reset.title: Reset progress
reset.body: Clears coins, unlocks, upgrades and ladder progress from this browser. This cannot be undone.

line-strength.name: Line strength
line-strength.description: A thicker, better-laid line resists abrasion and survives a higher peak tension before it parts.

gelasan.name: Gelasan
gelasan.description: The abrasive coating on your line — traditionally crushed glass bound with glue. Wears through the other line faster.

reel-speed.name: Reel speed
reel-speed.description: How many metres of line you can haul or pay out per second. Faster reeling means you reach a crossing on your terms.

control.name: Control
control.description: Cleaner bridle work. The sail answers your steering more quickly.

stamina.name: Stamina
stamina.description: Conditioned arms. You tire more slowly while hauling and recover faster between exchanges.

luck.name: Reputation
luck.description: A name on the field. Every coin reward is worth more.

senja.name: Senja
senja.description: Dusk orange and gold — the light kites actually fly in.

pandan.name: Pandan
pandan.description: The green of pandan leaf, with a pale lime edge.

samudra.name: Samudra
samudra.description: Deep sea blue running into shallow teal.

gula-kelapa.name: Gula Kelapa
gula-kelapa.description: White and red, the colours of palm sugar and rice.

batik-indigo.name: Batik Indigo
batik-indigo.description: Indigo dye with an unbleached cotton cream.

mercusuar.name: Mercusuar
mercusuar.description: Lighthouse yellow against a warning pink.

arang.name: Arang
arang.description: Charcoal on charcoal, with one ember-orange accent.

nusantara.name: Nusantara
nusantara.description: Violet, gold and teal together — loud on purpose.

none.name: None
none.description: No trail. The cleanest read of the arena.

debu.name: Dust
debu.description: A faint scatter of field dust behind the sail.

kunang.name: Fireflies
kunang.description: Slow warm motes that drift upward and fade.

asap.name: Smoke
asap.description: Soft grey plume that the wind pulls apart.

pelangi.name: Rainbow
pelangi.description: Dense trail tinted from your own colourway.

bara.name: Embers
bara.description: Hot orange sparks that rise and burn out.

shop.patternNote: Liveries are the sail graphics. Like colourways, they are cosmetic and do not change how a kite flies.

plain.name: Plain
plain.description: Bare panels, no graphics. The cleanest read of the airframe.

belang.name: Bands
belang.description: Horizontal bands across the sail, the most common village livery.

palang.name: Bars
palang.description: Vertical bars — easy to pick out against a bright sky.

seperempat.name: Quarters
seperempat.description: Opposing quadrants in two colours. The classic fighting kite.

panah.name: Chevrons
panah.description: Nested arrows pointing at the nose.

sasaran.name: Target
sasaran.description: Concentric rings centred on the bridle point.

bintang.name: Star
bintang.description: A five-pointed star with a contrasting centre.

papan.name: Checkerboard
papan.description: A full check, with one cell flipped so the grid does not read as texture.

lidah-api.name: Flames
lidah-api.description: Tongues of flame licking up from the tail edge.

kawung.name: Kawung
kawung.description: The four-petal Javanese batik lattice, drawn across the whole sail.

mata.name: Eyes
mata.description: Paired eyes, the way a bebean or an owl kite is painted.

sinar.name: Sunburst
sinar.description: Rays fanning out from the bridle. Loud, and meant to be.
